definitions.explanation: The spirit of a dead person that appears in the world of the living, often depicted in Japanese tradition as a pale figure with no feet.
Something that exists only in name or on paper, not in reality.

examples.japanese: {幽霊|ゆうれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{屋敷|やしき}→屋敷：12395_yashiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幽霊|ゆうれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧らしい。
examples.english: Apparently ghosts appear in this mansion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、{幽霊|ゆうれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れなく→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: As a child, when I heard ghost stories I couldn't sleep at night.

examples.japanese: {幽霊|ゆうれい}⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To watch out for ghost companies.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幽霊|ゆうれい}⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{除|のぞ}けば→除く：02391_nozoku⟧⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: If you exclude the phantom members, the actual number of active people in the organization is small.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditional Japanese {幽霊|ゆうれい} are typically depicted as pale figures wearing white burial kimono ({白装束|しろしょうぞく}), with long disheveled black hair, and characteristically lacking feet. This differs from Western ghosts. Classic examples include {四谷怪談|よつやかいだん} (Yotsuya Ghost Story).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幽霊|ゆうれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (a ghost appears)
- {幽霊|ゆうれい}{屋敷|やしき} (haunted mansion)
- {幽霊|ゆうれい}⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧ (shell company)
- {幽霊|ゆうれい}⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧ (phantom member)
- {幽霊|ゆうれい}{話|ばなし} (ghost story)
